(Symbol: VIKRAMSOLR, Series EQ) 
 
Dear Sir/ Madam, 
 
Sub: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations 2015 – Audio link for Earnings Call 
 
In compliance with Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Company Participated in an 
Earnings Conference Call with Investors today i.e. Friday, May 08, 2026 at 10:00 AM (IST) to discuss the 
financial performance of the Company for the quarter and year ended on March 31, 2026. 
 
Please note that no unpublished price sensitive information was shared / discussed in the meeting. 
 
The audio of the Earnings Conference Call has been uploaded at the website of the Company at 
www.vikramsolar.com  under the following link: 
 
vikramsolar.com/wp-content/themes/hello-elementor/img/vikram-solar-q4-fy26-earnings-call.mp3  
 
We request you to kindly take the aforesaid information on record. 
 
Thanking You, 
 
For and on behalf of  
VIKRAM SOLAR LIMITED 
 
 
 
SUDIPTA BHOWAL 
Company Secretary &  
Compliance Officer 
 
 
Sudipta 
Bhowal
Digitally signed by 
Sudipta Bhowal 
Date: 2026.05.08
